events.title: DEMO: Path Taken Result Graphic + Bugfixes
events.summary: Hey all, to give folks a smoother time I've fixed the below issues with the game.I've also added a "path taken" graphic to the results screen that lets the player know what path they took throughout the level!Patch NotesAdded a "path taken" graphic that happens at the end of each levelFixed two softlocksThe cursor should now always be "captured" within the windowMinor visual tweaks Gave Advent a little more HP
